Self-hosted Lenis (smooth scroll engine)
========================================
Put the file here:   assets/vendor/lenis/lenis.min.js

Download (pinned version 1.1.20):
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.1.20/dist/lenis.min.js

Save that URL's content as lenis.min.js in this folder. That is the only
manual step. Until the file exists the site simply uses normal scrolling
(with native smooth anchor jumps) — nothing breaks.

To upgrade later: change the version in the URL, replace the file, test.
Lenis CSS rules are already included in assets/css/1-base/scroll.css.
